capture_event.description: Record a product-analytics event against a person, with any properties you want to break it down by later. The person is named by a distinct ID - your own user ID, an email, anything stable - and PostHog creates them the first time it sees one. Events are queued for ingestion rather than stored on the spot, so an event captured here takes a moment to appear in PostHog and will not reliably be found by a 'List events' step immediately afterwards.

run_query.description: Run SQL (HogQL) over your PostHog data and get the rows back - counts, funnels, joins between events and people, anything the fixed list actions cannot express. Returns 'results' as a list of rows with 'columns' naming what is in each position. Use {placeholders} with the Values field rather than pasting a value into the SQL, so text carried over from an earlier step cannot be read as query syntax.

mock_response.query: SELECT event, count() AS total FROM events GROUP BY event

description: Drive PostHog product analytics from a workflow: send events and person properties in, read events, people and saved insights back out, run SQL over any of it, roll feature flags out and back, and mark releases on your charts. Works with PostHog Cloud in either region and with a self-hosted install.
